_readme: The freeplay menu's background: the main menu art, a colour wash over it, and a checker
that drifts across the whole thing forever. These are the built-in defaults - the file is
here so they can be changed without rebuilding. Back out of freeplay and go back in; it is
read fresh each time the menu is built.
The wash and the checker both take their colour from the selected song - the same colour
that tints its capsule, out of the third field of the song's entry in its week file.
bgSaturation and bgLightness adjust that colour before it is used; a week like week2, whose
colour is very dark and very grey, needs lifting or it reads as black.
The checker is described relative to the wash rather than as a colour of its own, so every
song keeps the same relationship instead of needing a second colour picked for it.
hueApart is in degrees around the colour wheel; the other two are added to the wash's own
saturation and lightness, on a 0 to 1 scale.
transitionMs is how long a colour change takes and ease names its curve: linear, quadOut,
cubeOut, expoOut, sineInOut or backOut. blend is how the two colours are mixed on the way:
'hue' sweeps the short way round the wheel, 'hueLong' takes the scenic route, and 'rgb'
cuts straight across, which can dip through grey between opposite colours. checkerLagMs
starts the checker's change after the wash's, so the two do not move as one sheet.
speed is pixels a second and direction is degrees, measuring the way the screen does: 0
drifts right, 90 down, 180 left, 270 up. tileSize is one square, so the pattern repeats
every two of them. blendMode is one of normal, add, multiply or screen.
checkerAlphaA and checkerAlphaB are the two squares' opacities, 0 to 1. Both squares take
the song's colour; an alpha of 0 turns that half of the pattern off.
fallbackColor is used where a song has no colour of its own - the RANDOM entry, mostly.
